stories.title: World Series Game 4: Takeaways from Rays' walk-off win to stave off elimination
stories.summary: Tampa Bay lives to fight another day after scoring two runs in the 12th inning in the 4-3 win on Tuesday night.

stories.title: Rays steal Game 4 from Brewers in extras to stay alive in World Series
stories.summary: The Rays avoided a sweep with a stunning 12th-inning rally versus the Brewers to take Game 4 of the World Series.

stories.title: Sources: Wolves' Edwards set for knee procedure, to miss up to 2 months
stories.summary: Timberwolves star Anthony Edwards will undergo an arthroscopic procedure on his ailing right knee Thursday that will sideline him up to two months, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Dream say concerns over finding available Finals venue went unheeded
stories.summary: In a letter to the city, the Atlanta Dream said Game 6 getting moved to 12:30 p.m. so they can play in State Farm Arena was "not what we fought for."

stories.title: Colts make second major trade, send DT Buckner back to 49ers
stories.summary: The Colts have traded DeForest Buckner to the Colts for a 2027 fourth-round pick.
